# UAR testing-methodology review

Source under review: `24f338519e21637051c0d34d8d8ffea4dd672099`

| Constraint | Observed result | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| Evidence limits | Pass: four guides and seven evidence classes state both proof and non-proof boundaries. | Taxonomy does not replace each change's exact commands. |
| Genuine inference | Pass: the synthetic-certification mutation failed; genuine inference requires a real loaded model through UAR. | No model request ran in this documentation change. |
| Negative controls | Pass: omission of observed failure failed closed; the guide requires bounded inversion and exact restoration. | Applies to fail-closed claims, not every positive test. |
| Timing and location | Pass: Tier 0–3, cohesive implementation, source/profile binding, and deployment-only Actions are explicit. | No product or release tier was executed. |
| Publication composition | Pass after classifying exactly `AGENTS.md` and the two stack-rule files as reviewed provenance sources. | Classification permits synthesis; it does not publish every policy file directly. |

## Uncomfortable finding

The first composed run failed because the new pages cited three current policy
sources that the publication manifest had not classified. The focused validator
alone passed. Composition caught a real provenance gap, and the repair added only
those exact files to the existing implementation-provenance rule.

## Deferred evidence

Runtime tests, genuine model inference, load/soak behavior, production build,
browser/navigation, accessibility, Pages deployment, live routes, and cross-profile
readiness remain outside this review.
